title: RfpList checklist progress reads `r.dcfg_contract_fe` â€” always undefined, progress stuck at 3/4 max
detail: Line 63: `const checkCount = [r.dcfg_bid_solicited, r.dcfg_bid_received, r.dcfg_scope_exhibit_drafted, r.dcfg_contract_fe].filter(Boolean).length;`. `dcfg_contract_fe` does not match the portalApi.js $select (which requests `dcfg_contract_fee`) nor any known boolean column. The server returns `dcfg_contract_fee` (money), the code reads `dcfg_contract_fe` (undefined), filter(Boolean) drops it, checkCount never reaches 4. Every RFP package displays at most 3/4 progress regardless of actual state.
recommendedFix: Same fix as CR-2026-04-09-0290 â€” verify schema and update the key everywhere (RfpList.jsx:63, RfpDetail.jsx:131, portalApi.js:772).
